clips.title: The story
paras: In Shadowfang Keep, Fenrus the Devourer prowls the upper sanctum. Archmage Arugal keeps the enormous worg as a pet and guardian, its body swollen by unnatural magic. Intruders seeking the archmage's study must face the beast and its master.

Fenrus the Devourer lurks outside Archmage Arugal's personal chambers deep within Shadowfang Keep. Unlike the worgen on the ramparts, Fenrus is a worg, swollen to enormous size. The beast prowls among the shelves, scrolls, and arcane apparatus in Arugal's private study. The archmage keeps Fenrus as both pet and guard against anyone who comes seeking his head.

Fenrus's unnatural bulk points to dark magic saturating the keep since Baron Silverlaine's downfall. Archmage Arugal or his unleashed worgen warped the creature through arcane or shadowy experiments, turning a native predator into a ravenous juggernaut. Fenrus is so feral and bound by magic that no hunter can charm or tame him.
